role: MARKET_CALIBRATED_CENTRAL_V2: observed-trend counterpart to the owner-approved policy-central; state paths differ by design. v1 is the policy-registered central (what enacted policies imply); v2 is the market-calibrated central (what observed 2016-2025 market trends imply, with policy entering only as a floor or retained statutory/target anchors); neither is a forecast — they bracket whether the turning is policy-driven or already latent in observed market motion.

right_censoring.policy: REPORTED_NEVER_IMPUTED: 24 jurisdictions have no sustained-nonincrease onset by 2075 under observed market trends; their onset years are packaged as NaN (displayed '>2075'), never filled with 2075, and they are excluded from onset summaries.

conditional_band.note: No conditional prediction band is registered for the market-calibrated central; bands remain registered for the policy-central line only and are not transferred or fabricated here.

framing_vs_policy_central: v1 is the policy-registered central (what enacted policies imply); v2 is the market-calibrated central (what observed 2016-2025 market trends imply, with policy entering only as a floor or retained statutory/target anchors); neither is a forecast — they bracket whether the turning is policy-driven or already latent in observed market motion.

boundary_strings_stamped_from_atlas.grid_boundary: eGRID2023 state generation attributional direct CO2; not delivered-electricity mix, marginal emissions, or a forecast
boundary_strings_stamped_from_atlas.carrier_input_estimand: annual operational ATS-incremental carrier input for the normalized reference bundle; propulsion and conventional signal-core energy excluded
boundary_strings_stamped_from_atlas.direct_co2_estimand: scope-matched operational direct CO2: eGRID state total-output attributional electricity CO2 plus EPA gasoline tailpipe CO2; upstream, non-CO2 and embodied terms excluded
boundary_strings_stamped_from_atlas.claim_boundary: deterministic comparative scenarios, not empirical forecasts, causal policy effects, city or urban-rural estimands, carbon-neutrality dates, or cumulative payback dates

claim_boundary: Market-calibrated deterministic scenarios for normalized synthetic reference bundles; registered extrapolations of observed 2016-2025 trends, not empirical forecasts, probability intervals, causal policy effects, actual state totals, carbon-neutrality dates, or cumulative payback dates.
